objects.label: AI Governance Ownership
objects.statement: The organization must designate a person or function with overall accountability for AI governance, including policy development, risk oversight, and compliance monitoring.
objects.intent: Ensure clear ownership and accountability for AI governance across the organization.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop, deploy, or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: AI governance role description, assignment documentation, org chart showing AI governance structure, meeting minutes of governance reviews
objects.related_controls: AI Policy Framework, Top Management Commitment, Governance Roles and Responsibilities
implementation_guidance: Define AI governance role with documented responsibilities
Assign to an accountable individual or committee
Include in job descriptions and performance objectives

objects.label: Human Oversight for High-Risk AI
objects.statement: High-risk AI systems must be designed and operated in a way that enables effective human oversight, including the ability for humans to intervene, override, or stop the system when necessary.
objects.intent: Ensure human judgment remains the final authority for consequential AI decisions, preventing full automation of decisions with significant impact.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying high-risk AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Human oversight design documentation, approval workflow definitions, human review logs, override records
objects.related_controls: Human Oversight Control, Approval Workflow, Human Intervention Mechanism
implementation_guidance: Identify decision points requiring human review

objects.label: Human Approval Workflow
objects.statement: The organization must establish documented approval workflows for AI system decisions, specifying who must approve which types of decisions, under what conditions, and within what timeframe.
objects.intent: Ensure decisions of consequence are routed through a documented, accountable approval process before execution.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems that make consequential decisions
objects.expected_evidence: Approval workflow documentation, approval records, escalation logs, workflow review records
objects.related_controls: Approval Workflow, Human Oversight Control, Escalation Procedure

objects.label: Human Intervention Mechanism
objects.statement: The organization must implement mechanisms that allow authorized human operators to intervene, override, or halt AI system actions in real time when necessary to prevent harm or correct erroneous behavior.
objects.intent: Ensure humans can stop or correct AI actions when necessary.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying high-risk AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Intervention mechanism design documentation, intervention procedure documents, training completion records, intervention logs
objects.related_controls: Human Oversight Control, Emergency Stop, Rollback Procedure

objects.label: AI Policy Framework
objects.statement: The organization must establish, document, and maintain an AI policy that defines governance principles, risk tolerance, ethical commitments, and compliance requirements for AI systems.
objects.intent: Provide a formal, documented foundation for AI governance that communicates organizational commitments and expectations.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop, deploy, or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Approved AI policy document, communication records, training completion records, policy review records
objects.related_controls: AI Governance Ownership, Top Management Commitment, Policy Communication and Training
implementation_guidance: Draft AI policy with input from legal, risk, and technical stakeholders
Publish and communicate to all relevant staff

objects.label: Data Quality for AI Systems
objects.statement: The organization must ensure that data used for training, validation, and operation of AI systems is of sufficient quality, including accuracy, completeness, relevance, and representativeness for the intended use.
objects.intent: Prevent AI system errors and biases caused by poor quality data.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Data quality criteria documentation, data quality assessment reports, remediation records, data quality monitoring logs
objects.related_controls: Data Quality Control, Data Validation, Data Monitoring

objects.label: Data Lineage and Provenance
objects.statement: The organization must maintain data lineage records that track the origin, transformation, and flow of data used in AI systems from source to consumption, enabling traceability and auditability.
objects.intent: Enable traceability of data used in AI systems for audit, compliance, and error investigation.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Data lineage records, data flow diagrams, transformation logs, lineage verification records
objects.related_controls: Data Tracking, Data Provenance, Audit Logging

objects.label: Data Classification for AI Systems
objects.statement: The organization must classify data used in AI systems according to sensitivity, regulatory requirements, and risk, and apply appropriate controls based on classification.
objects.intent: Ensure appropriate protection for data based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements.
objects.applicability: All organizations that process data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Data classification schema, classification assignments, control implementation records, classification review records
objects.related_controls: Data Protection, Access Control, Data Handling Procedures
implementation_guidance: Classify data used in AI systems

objects.label: AI System Disclosure
objects.statement: Users must be informed when they are interacting with an AI system, including the nature and purpose of the system, in a clear and understandable manner.
objects.intent: Ensure users are aware they are interacting with AI and can make informed decisions about their engagement.
objects.applicability: All organizations with user-facing AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Disclosure mechanism implementation records, user awareness verification, disclosure policy documents
objects.related_controls: Transparency Control, User Notification, Consent Management

objects.label: Synthetic Content Labeling
objects.statement: AI-generated synthetic content (including text, images, audio, and video) must be clearly labeled as AI-generated or AI-manipulated in a machine-readable and human-readable format.
objects.intent: Prevent deception by ensuring users can identify AI-generated content.
objects.applicability: Organizations that generate synthetic content using AI
objects.expected_evidence: Labeling implementation records, content labeling examples, integrity verification records
objects.related_controls: Content Labeling, Provenance Tracking, Integrity Verification

objects.label: Deepfake Disclosure
objects.statement: Deepfake content (AI-generated or manipulated image, audio, or video that resembles real persons or events) must be clearly disclosed as artificially generated or manipulated.
objects.intent: Prevent misinformation and deception through realistic synthetic media.
objects.applicability: Organizations that generate or distribute deepfake content
objects.expected_evidence: Deepfake detection records, disclosure labels, disclosure event logs, compliance monitoring records
objects.related_controls: Content Labeling, Deepfake Detection, Disclosure Management
implementation_guidance: Ensure labels are visible and understandable

objects.label: Top Management Commitment
objects.statement: Top management must demonstrate commitment to AI governance by approving the AI policy, allocating resources, and regularly reviewing AI governance performance.
objects.intent: Ensure AI governance has executive-level support and resources to be effective.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop, deploy, or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Executive meeting minutes, approved resource allocation documents, governance review reports, signed policy approval
objects.related_controls: AI Governance Ownership, AI Policy Framework, Governance Review Cadence
implementation_guidance: Schedule regular AI governance reviews at executive level
Include AI governance in board or management reporting

objects.label: AI System Logging
objects.statement: AI systems must log all material decisions, actions, and events, including inputs, outputs, decision rationale, and human interventions, in a format suitable for audit and review.
objects.intent: Enable audit, investigation, and continuous improvement through complete records of AI system behavior.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Logging policy, log records, log retrieval test results, log integrity verification records
objects.related_controls: Audit Logging Control, Log Retention, Log Integrity

objects.label: Audit Trail Retention
objects.statement: The organization must retain audit trails for AI systems for a defined retention period (minimum 5 years for high-risk systems) in a tamper-evident format that supports retrieval and replay.
objects.intent: Ensure evidence is available for audits, investigations, and regulatory reviews.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Retention policy document, retention implementation records, retrieval test results, retention compliance reports
objects.related_controls: Log Retention, Data Archiving, Evidence Management
implementation_guidance: Define retention periods by risk tier

objects.label: Audit Trail Retrieval
objects.statement: The organization must be able to retrieve audit trails for AI systems upon request from authorized parties (auditors, regulators, data subjects) within a reasonable timeframe.
objects.intent: Enable timely response to audit and regulatory requests.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Retrieval procedure documentation, retrieval test results, response time records, retrieval request logs
objects.related_controls: Log Retrieval, Audit Response, Data Access

objects.label: AI Governance Roles and Responsibilities
objects.statement: The organization must define and document roles, responsibilities, and authorities for AI governance, including who is accountable for AI system decisions, risk management, and compliance.
objects.intent: Ensure clear accountability for AI-related decisions and activities across the organization.
objects.applicability: All organizations that develop, deploy, or operate AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: RACI matrix, role descriptions, org chart, accountability assignment records
objects.related_controls: Human Oversight, Accountability Chain, Access Control
implementation_guidance: Map AI governance roles to organizational structure
Communicate roles to all relevant personnel

objects.label: Human Accountability for AI Outcomes
objects.statement: The organization must ensure that every consequential AI decision has a clearly identified human accountable for the outcome, with documented responsibility and authority.
objects.intent: Maintain human responsibility for AI outcomes, preventing accountability gaps.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems that make consequential decisions
objects.expected_evidence: Accountability assignment records, accountability documentation, training records, incident review records
objects.related_controls: Human Oversight Control, Accountability Chain, Incident Management
implementation_guidance: Map AI decisions to accountable humans

objects.label: AI Risk Management System
objects.statement: The organization must establish, implement, and maintain a risk management system for AI systems that identifies, analyzes, evaluates, treats, and monitors AI-related risks throughout the AI system lifecycle.
objects.intent: Ensure systematic identification and management of AI risks from design through deployment and operation.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying high-risk AI systems; all organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Risk assessment methodology document, completed risk assessments, risk treatment plans, risk monitoring records, risk review meeting minutes
objects.related_controls: Risk Assessment, Risk Treatment, Risk Monitoring, Risk Review
implementation_guidance: Conduct risk assessments for all AI systems

objects.label: AI System Security
objects.statement: AI systems must be protected against unauthorized access, manipulation, and misuse through appropriate security controls, including access control, encryption, and monitoring.
objects.intent: Prevent security breaches that could compromise AI system integrity, confidentiality, or availability.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Security control implementation records, security assessment results, incident response records, monitoring logs
objects.related_controls: Access Control, Encryption, Security Monitoring, Incident Response

objects.label: AI System Security Testing
objects.statement: AI systems must be tested for security vulnerabilities before deployment and periodically during operation, with findings documented and remediated.
objects.intent: Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.
objects.applicability: All organizations with AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Security testing reports, vulnerability remediation records, testing schedule, penetration test results
objects.related_controls: Vulnerability Management, Security Testing, Penetration Testing

objects.label: AI Risk Classification
objects.statement: The organization must classify each AI system according to its risk level, considering the potential impact on health, safety, fundamental rights, and organizational objectives.
objects.intent: Enable proportionate governance by matching controls to risk level.
objects.applicability: All organizations that deploy AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Risk classification criteria document, classification records per AI system, classification review records
objects.related_controls: Risk Assessment, Proportional Controls, Risk-based Approval
implementation_guidance: Assess each AI system against criteria

objects.label: Lawful Basis for Personal Data Processing
objects.statement: The organization must establish and document a lawful basis for all processing of personal data by AI systems, including consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interest, public task, or legitimate interest.
objects.intent: Ensure all personal data processing by AI systems has a valid legal foundation.
objects.applicability: Organizations processing personal data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Lawful basis documentation, privacy notices, consent records (if applicable), processing activity records
objects.related_controls: Data Protection Impact Assessment, Privacy Notice, Consent Management
implementation_guidance: Map AI data processing to lawful bases

objects.label: Data Subject Rights
objects.statement: The organization must support data subject rights in AI systems, including the right to access, correct, delete, restrict processing, object, and data portability, with documented procedures and response timelines.
objects.intent: Protect individual rights regarding personal data processed by AI systems.
objects.applicability: Organizations processing personal data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Rights request procedures, request response records, response time monitoring, training records
objects.related_controls: Data Subject Request Management, Privacy Rights, Access Control
implementation_guidance: Map data subject rights to AI systems

objects.label: Data Protection Impact Assessment
objects.statement: The organization must conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for AI systems that process personal data, particularly where processing is likely to result in high risk to individuals' rights and freedoms.
objects.intent: Identify and mitigate privacy risks before AI systems process personal data.
objects.applicability: Organizations processing personal data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: DPIA documentation, mitigation records, approval records, review records
objects.related_controls: Privacy Impact Assessment, Risk Assessment, Data Protection
implementation_guidance: Conduct DPIAs for high-risk AI systems

objects.label: Sensitive Data Protection
objects.statement: The organization must apply enhanced protections for sensitive personal data (e.g., health data, biometric data, racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs) processed by AI systems, including explicit consent where required.
objects.intent: Ensure enhanced protection for sensitive data that carries higher privacy risk.
objects.applicability: Organizations processing sensitive personal data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Sensitive data identification records, enhanced control implementation, consent records, monitoring logs
objects.related_controls: Data Classification, Enhanced Data Protection, Consent Management

objects.label: Privacy Impact Assessment
objects.statement: The organization must conduct privacy impact assessments for AI systems that process personal data, evaluating privacy risks and implementing appropriate mitigations before deployment.
objects.intent: Systematically identify and address privacy risks in AI systems.
objects.applicability: Organizations processing personal data through AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: PIA documentation, mitigation records, approval records, review records
objects.related_controls: Data Protection Impact Assessment, Risk Assessment, Data Protection

objects.label: AI Impact Assessment
objects.statement: The organization must conduct impact assessments for high-risk AI systems to evaluate potential effects on individuals, communities, and organizational operations before deployment.
objects.intent: Identify and mitigate potential negative impacts before AI systems are deployed.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying high-risk AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Completed impact assessments, mitigation plans, approval records, review records
objects.related_controls: Risk Assessment, Privacy Impact Assessment, Human Rights Impact Assessment
implementation_guidance: Conduct assessments for high-risk AI systems

objects.label: AI System Safety Testing
objects.statement: AI systems must be tested for safety before deployment, including testing for harmful outputs, unintended behaviors, and failure modes, with results documented and reviewed.
objects.intent: Prevent harm from AI system failures or unintended behaviors.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Safety testing records, test reports, remediation records, approval records
objects.related_controls: Safety Testing, Safety Monitoring, Risk Assessment

objects.label: Safety Thresholds and Monitoring
objects.statement: The organization must define safety thresholds for AI system behavior and continuously monitor system performance against these thresholds during operation.
objects.intent: Detect and respond to unsafe AI system behavior during operation.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Safety threshold documentation, monitoring records, alert records, incident records
objects.related_controls: Safety Monitoring, Alerting, Incident Response

objects.label: AI System Rollback and Suspension
objects.statement: The organization must have documented procedures to suspend or roll back AI systems when unsafe behavior is detected, with clear authority and escalation paths.
objects.intent: Enable rapid response to unsafe AI system behavior.
objects.applicability: Organizations deploying AI systems
objects.expected_evidence: Rollback/suspension procedures, exercise records, incident records, authority assignment records
objects.related_controls: Incident Response, Emergency Procedures, Rollback Capability
